steps: Download the free Premise app (iOS/Android) and create an account with your email.
Browse the task marketplace and pick tasks (photos, surveys, price checks, location records).
Complete the task within its deadline; each completed task earns a set reward.
Cash out from your in-app wallet — paid instantly via PayPal, Payoneer, or Bitcoin (country-dependent).
timing: Paid instantly on cashout via PayPal, Payoneer, or Bitcoin (depending on country) — same-day.
who_pays: Premise pays you a reward for each task you successfully complete.
who_qualifies: The iOS/Android app; available globally in 50+ countries. Which payout methods you can use depends on your country.
work_available: Depends on partner demand in your area — availability fluctuates by country and city, so this is pocket money for errands you're already running, not steady work.
what_gets_accepted: Tasks must be completed and accepted per the task instructions; reward amounts vary per task. Some tasks are unpaid 'profile-building' tasks that improve your access to paid ones.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: the profile-building tasks (unpaid by design) and travel to task locations. Typical tasks pay very little (around $0.20 per third-party reports — Premise itself doesn't publish per-task amounts).
when_cash_arrives: Instantly on cashout via PayPal, Payoneer, or Bitcoin, depending on which options your country supports — same-day once you hit cashout.

repeatable.cadence: New tasks post regularly — complete a task, cash out instantly via PayPal/Payoneer, and pick up the next one.
